name: 树脂风井独立房间环境 v1
collision: none; existing room collision and authored furnishings are drawn separately

palette.primary: warm cream ivory and pale honey limestone
palette.accent: tender green leaves, occasional violet pollen flowers, amber outer roots

composition: 独立花蕊风井与导风叶瓣；完整独立绘制背景，统一琥珀巨叶文明和暖白小石砖。

safe_margin.foreground_obstacles: No furniture or hard terrain is painted inside the mapped playable center. Small seam moss and edge flowers are nonblocking landscape detail.

notes: 每房使用一次独立 built-in image_gen 生成的完整原画；旧族环境只作风格、色卡与小石砖尺度参考。
角色、敌人、HUD、功能目标与奖励宝匣由运行时绘制，不嵌入此背景。
原始 PNG 完整复制，无像素编辑、拼贴或缩放。
placement_normalized_rect 沿用当前固定映射；可走多边形按本房实际干地独立拟合，所有布局锚点到边界至少 30 世界像素。

boundary.authority: independent painted dry stone edge / low root bank; reviewed per room
boundary.validation_status: actual layout geometry and production GPU suite passed

runtime_chunks.texture_memory: one shared texture; no streaming claim

qa.geometry_status: 28-room actual layout anchor and complete route clearance audit passed

runtime_validation.scope: production room prepare/apply; authored gameplay preservation; navigation; background/chunk/camera/minimap identity; Chinese/English UI window matrix
